NBA DFS Rankings for Tuesday, November 24 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Tuesday, November 24 · 3 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 24, 8:40 AM ET

Nikola Jokic (DEN) ranks first on the Tuesday, November 24 DraftKings main slate at 62.5 projected DraftKings points for $11,700. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 51.1) and Cade Cunningham (DET, 49.4) are next.

The table ranks all 51 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 24, 8:40 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
